name: Woodworks Studio
old_description: Gift certificates never expire and can be used for any class. So, you don't have to worry that you are choosing the exact right class! They can sign up after the holidays and use the funds for any class they like!
about:
Woodworks Studio operates at 2555 S Santa Fe, Unit F2, in Denver, Colorado. The studio has offered woodworking instruction for over two decades, with the lead instructor teaching beginner classes for more than 20 years.

The studio provides woodworking education through beginner, intermediate, private, and intensive workshop formats. Beginner classes cover safe operation of table saws, jointers, planers, miter saws, and routers to build a small table or bookcase, including panel glue-up, basic joinery, and finishing techniques. Intermediate classes are student-directed, allowing participants to design and build projects such as jewelry boxes, butcher blocks, coffee tables, dining tables, bookshelves, and cabinets while learning advanced joinery like mortise-and-tenon and dovetails. Private classes offer guided project work for groups. Intensive week-long workshops focus on basic woodworking and cabinet building in small groups.

Classes serve hobbyists, beginners, and intermediate woodworkers seeking hands-on instruction. Customers include individuals purchasing gift certificates — which never expire and are transferable across any class — as well as those scheduling private or semi-private sessions.

The instructor emphasizes safety, noting no significant injuries in over 20 years of teaching beginner classes. The studio aims to provide quality instruction with no hidden fees for beginner classes, and flexible scheduling for intermediate classes that never expire.
